summary: the smallest time step that still covers the simulated time within a budget of steps

inputs.name: simulated_time
inputs.meaning: the physical time the run must cover

inputs.name: step_budget
inputs.meaning: the number of steps the run may take; a budget, bound to a row with its own source

outputs.name: time_step_min
outputs.meaning: the lower bound on the time step from the budget

validity: any time-marching run with a fixed step; an adaptive step makes this a mean, not a bound

source.citation: by definition: the simulated time divided by the number of steps
source.locus: the budget is an input, not a property of this skill
